{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''The Third Battle''''' was an account of the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], that was written by [[Pupaku]], a [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] who had fought for the [[Hutt Empire]] during the battle. In it, he wrote a number of moving tributes to the Klatooinians, [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], [[Vodran (species)/Legends|Vodran]], and [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] whom he had fought alongside during the battle.
